limitations: The theorem is one-dimensional; it does not treat resonant amplitudes, the critical measure-one case, stable sampling/frame bounds, or remove the higher-dimensional small-norm hypothesis. provenance: Extension of the irrational-rotation universal-completeness construction in arXiv:2609.20805 by replacing its small-amplitude pole and separation estimates with finite-amplitude nonresonant estimates.
record_title: Amplitude-free universal completeness for irrational-rotation quasicrystals
